notes: Capital House buy-cooldown UI. After a house buy, the Execute button reds out and shows a live mm:ss countdown to the next allowed buy (mirrors the day-trade lock) instead of only surfacing a raw 'buy_rate_limited' string on a blocked click. Server-authoritative: the fund snapshot now carries buyCooldownMs (remaining) and buyCooldownWindowMs (full window), so the countdown is correct on first render, after a buy, on reload, and on any fund broadcast. SELL stays enabled during the cooldown (sells are uncapped); flipping the side toggle relocks/unlocks accordingly. The trade hint now shows the friendly server message (with the wait time) rather than the error code. SERVER + CLIENT (server/server.js snapshot field, client/assets/funds.js): pm2 restart fleshmarket required; funds.js is served no-cache so it revalidates on next load (hard-refresh if in doubt).
